# Peely Pix identity data

`raw/peely-pix-names.json` contains the complete 25-entry generic path-to-name map
from [glowseeker/cephalon-kronos](https://github.com/glowseeker/cephalon-kronos),
pinned to commit `08887d766ddfd03c855be200053daa19c4f9705d` (2026-06-02).
The source file contains paths and names only; this snapshot does not include
inventory quantities, personal Riven data, or profile-derived values.

The source repository is MIT licensed; its root license notes that Warframe game
data, names, and imagery remain Digital Extremes property and acknowledges
[Warframe Public Export Plus](https://github.com/calamity-inc/warframe-public-export-plus)
as a game-data source. The separate Commons Clause in that repository applies
only to a bundled `warframe-api-helper` binary, which is not included here.

The official [Update 38.5 notes](https://www.warframe.com/en/patch-notes/pc/38-5-0)
describe Peely Pix as sticker rewards and document their duplicate-based upgrade
levels. Tenno Hub imports these records from AlecaFrame's stacked `RawUpgrades`
section as counted inventory items, not ordinary mods.
